name: Golden Milk (Turmeric & Ginger Oat Latte)
whyItWorks: Warm oat milk whisked with anti-inflammatory turmeric, cinnamon, ginger, and maple syrup.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm 1 cup oat or lactose-free milk with 1/2 tsp ground turmeric, a pinch of cinnamon, ground ginger, and 1 tsp maple syrup or honey.
